comment: The assembly of the assembly cut UI tests (mitcad#2131, mitcad#2160), made in the folder of plate.mitcad: the plate linked at the origin (plate:1, its block F1.b0); in the root Sketch1 (F2) on XZ with a 2 x 40 mm rectangle beside the Z axis, from z -15 to 25 (the Revolve's profile), and Sketch2 (F3) on XY with a 12 x 4 mm square inside the block (the Extrude's, the newest profile).
